On October 10, 2025, the vivo Developer Conference (VDC) took place in Shenzhen, where the highly anticipated OriginOS 6 system was officially unveiled, drawing widespread attention both inside and outside the venue. However, in the view of Leifeng.com, the true hidden star of this VDC was the 2025 Blue Heart Intelligent Strategy, as the content of this strategic upgrade directly impacts the personal experience of every user.

With the strategic upgrade, vivo's Blue Heart large model achieved comprehensive breakthroughs. By 2025, AI in China is no longer a distant concept. Data shows that 78% of enterprises use AI in their operations, and 71% rely on generative AI for marketing, operations, and product development. When it comes to the practicality of AI, most people would likely answer affirmatively.

Yet, such AI often carries a bit of a "corporate feel" and hasn't truly integrated into the daily lives of ordinary people. Take the most frequently used device—the smartphone—as an example: how many AI-related features do you actually use? Probably, most people treat large AI models merely as search engines; while "practical," they aren't considered "user-friendly."

So, how can large AI models become more integrated into our lives and more user-friendly? vivo's answer is "personalization." Indeed, current large models have extensive knowledge of the world but relatively little and short-term understanding of individuals, making it difficult to provide sustained, long-term personal service. Only when models become personalized can the full potential of large models be unleashed.

However, achieving "personalized" intelligence is no easy task.

Con la mejora estratégica, el gran modelo Blue Heart de vivo logró avances integrales. Al entrar en 2025, la IA en China ya no es un concepto inalcanzable. Los datos muestran que el 78% de las empresas utilizan IA en sus operaciones, y el 71% también emplea IA generativa para marketing, mantenimiento y desarrollo.

Author: Yang Yiting | Editor: Bao Yonggang
As the global tech industry accelerates into the AI era, the storage sector is undergoing a profound paradigm shift. The once cyclical market is now dominated by strong, sustained structural growth, a consensus highlighted at the recent GMIF 2025 Innovation Summit.
Historically, the storage market has experienced cyclical fluctuations: prices plummet during oversupply and rebound briefly with rising demand. Driven by AI, the industry is now entering a phase of continuous high growth.
Market forecasts indicate that the new storage market will reach nearly $200 billion by 2025, a year-on-year increase of approximately 17%, and is expected to expand further to around $230 billion by 2027.
At the summit, Han Xiaomin, General Manager of Aijiwei Consulting, analyzed that the current recovery in the storage industry is fueled not by smartphones and PCs but by AI-driven computational demands. He noted that while the primary growth driver remains large-scale investments from North American internet giants, China ranks second globally in AI but faces constraints due to limited advanced chip supply.
However, recent increases in cloud infrastructure investment plans by major domestic internet firms like Alibaba and ByteDance suggest that actual market growth may exceed the earlier 17% forecast, potentially reaching around 22%.

Un mercado antes marcado por fluctuaciones cíclicas evidentes está siendo impulsado por una fuerte y sostenida fuerza de crecimiento estructural, un cambio consensuado en la reciente Cumbre de Innovación GMIF 2025. Históricamente, el mercado de almacenamiento ha mostrado volatilidad cíclica: los precios se desploman con exceso de capacidad y repuntan brevemente al recuperarse la demanda. Impulsado por la demanda de IA, el sector ahora avanza hacia un canal de alto crecimiento sostenido. Las proyecciones indican que el mercado de almacenamiento emergente alcanzará casi 200.000 millones de dólares en 2025, con un crecimiento interanual aproximado del 1%.
